description: Minimal core permissions for the yagura main window: it only listens to the session events emitted by the Rust core and reads whether the main window is minimized. Every application command registered in main.rs's `generate_handler!` is not permission-gated by Tauri (no app manifest restricts commands) and validates its input in Rust instead. The non-core permissions are dialog:allow-open, which the Browse... folder picker needs, and clipboard-manager:allow-read-text / allow-write-text, which copy and paste in a window need (text only: no image, HTML or clear access); no fs: permission is granted and no filesystem plugin is registered.
